card.name: Words just before a linking preposition
card.fires_on: Ordinary web-text words, often a noun or verb, that expect a linking word such as on, of, to or for next. Seen in general web prose, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Verb before 'to'
modes.description: A verb like 'led' that is followed by 'to' introducing a result.
modes.example: which has<< led>> to development of sport-specific frames

modes.label: Noun before 'of' or 'to'
modes.description: A noun such as 'defense', 'way' or 'promise' that takes a following preposition or infinitive.
modes.example: is a standard<< way>> to gauge seasonal river flows

modes.label: Preposition before 'this site'
modes.description: The word 'on' before a site reference in web notices.
modes.example: elsewhere<< on>> this site. You will receive an email
